zero_omission_notes.summary: This chapter explores decimal numbers as extensions of place value to fractional units: tenths (1/10 = 0.1), hundredths (1/100 = 0.01), and thousandths (1/1000 = 0.001). It details measurement conversions (mm to cm, p to ₹), place value expansion, order comparison, addition, and subtraction algorithms.

detailed_sections.section_number_and_title: 3.1 Concept of Tenths and Sub-Unit Measurement
detailed_sections.full_notes: When 1 unit is partitioned into 10 equal parts, each part is one-tenth (1/10 = 0.1). Dividing one-tenth into 10 equal parts yields one-hundredth (1/100 = 0.01). The decimal point separates whole units from fractional parts.

margin_notes_and_sidebars.title: Origins of Decimals
margin_notes_and_sidebars.content: Decimal place value extends the base-10 structure rightwards indefinitely using negative powers of 10.

detailed_sections.section_number_and_title: 3.2 Conversion Rules for Currency and Length
detailed_sections.full_notes: 1. Currency: 1 Rupee = 100 Paise => 1 Paise = ₹0.01. 45 Paise = ₹0.45. 2. Length: 1 cm = 10 mm => 1 mm = 0.1 cm. 1 m = 100 cm = 1000 mm => 1 mm = 0.001 m.

Decimal addition and subtraction mandate vertical decimal point alignment. Equivalent decimals (e.g., 0.2 = 0.20 = 0.200) allow appending zeros to equalize decimal places before executing column arithmetic.

margin_notes_and_sidebars.title: Alignment Mandate
margin_notes_and_sidebars.content: Always align decimal points vertically prior to addition or subtraction.

practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.aim_or_objective: Measure small physical objects in centimeters and tenths using a millimeter ruler
procedure_or_steps: Align object starting edge to the 0 mark on ruler.
Count additional mm ticks as tenths of a cm.
practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.observations_or_results: Eraser = 2 cm 4 mm = 2.4 cm. Pencil = 4 cm 5 mm = 4.5 cm.
practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.conclusion_or_principle: Millimeters represent tenths of a centimeter (1 mm = 0.1 cm).

diagrams_figures_and_maps.drawing_or_reading_instructions: Magnify the region between 2 cm and 3 cm to show 10 equal divisions.

master_glossary_units_and_formulas.definition_or_meaning: One of ten equal parts of a whole (1/10)
One of hundred equal parts of a whole (1/100)
Decimals that represent the same value despite having trailing zeros

textbook_exercises.question: Honeybee body parts: Head = 2.3 units, Thorax = 5.4 units, Abdomen = 7.5 units. Find total length.

short_answer_questions.question: Find the difference in length between Celestial Pearl Danio (2.4 cm) and Philippine Goby (0.9 cm).

analytical_reasoning_questions.question: Compare 0.2 and 0.09 and explain which is larger.
analytical_reasoning_questions.answer: Comparing place values: 0.2 has 2 tenths, while 0.09 has 0 tenths. Since 2 tenths > 0 tenths, 0.2 > 0.09.

comprehensive_long_answers.question: Travel insurance costs 45 paise per passenger. If 1 lakh passengers buy insurance in a day, calculate total fee collected in Rupees.
comprehensive_long_answers.answer:
Total fee in paise = 100,000 * 45 = 4,500,000 paise.
Conversion to Rupees: 1 Rupee = 100 Paise.
Total fee = 4,500,000 / 100 = ₹45,000.

competency_and_case_studies.case_scenario: Three lab specimens measure: A = 5.5 cm, B = 6.4 cm, C = 6.39 cm.

qa.question: Identify the shortest specimen and calculate its difference from the longest.
qa.answer: Shortest = A (5.50 cm). Longest = B (6.40 cm). Difference = 6.40 - 5.50 = 0.90 cm (9 mm).

common_misconceptions_and_pitfalls.correct_fact_or_method: Compare digit by digit starting from the tenths position: 0.20 > 0.09.
